rounds.text: MIC Electronics Ltd is undergoing a powerful operational turnaround that is currently being masked by stale market sentiment [E63]. Sales growth has been exceptional, surging by 140% over 5 years and 146% over 3 years [E14, E15], backed by a robust TTM operating margin of 28% that reflects a five-percentage-point expansion over three years [E25]. This commercial momentum is translating into tangible financial health, evidenced by positive operating cash flow of Rs 4 Cr and free cash flow of Rs 2 Cr in March 2026 [E30, E31], alongside a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21x and a reduction in total borrowings down to Rs 44 Cr [E33, E34]. Furthermore, valuation multiples such as EV/EBITDA at 34.46x sit at a massive discount to the sector benchmark of 329.57x [E10], while foreign institutional investors have stepped up their stake by 5.58 percentage points since September 2023 [E37]. Conceded: promoter holding has decreased by 23.05 percentage points down to 51.58% [E36], and the stock trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E41].
